title: Gallery site screen recording: startup launch videos + paste-ready prompt breakdown
summary: A silent 11 s screen recording of a web gallery ('Discover startup launch videos from X'): fast scroll through a 4-column grid of video thumbnails, then a detail view showing a launch video next to its 'Paste-ready prompt' (HyperFrames/GSAP stack, beat sheet), then a component library grid (cards, stats, widgets). It is a reference for where good launch-video prompts live, not a motion-design piece itself.
fit_reason: Plain browser capture with no motion design; useful only as a resource (prompt structure for launch videos) and as an example of a raw 'show the screen' scroll.

palette.mood: light airy web UI, white with thumbnail colour

typography.display: site UI sans (Inter-like) medium, small mono metadata under thumbnails
typography.size_behaviour: small UI text; one centred page title
typography.notes: Detail page shows the prompt in monospace: 'Make a 10-second 16:9 product launch video for [PRODUCT NAME]... Stack: HyperFrames (HTML + GSAP)... beat sheet...'. Worth reading the original page for prompt structure.

transitions: hard cuts between pages (5.0 s, 8.0 s)
ui_treatment: raw full-screen browser capture, no zoom, no framing
signature_moves: fast grid scroll as a 'look how much there is' beat
split view: finished video left, the exact prompt that made it right

best_segments.what: Detail view: launch video thumbnail beside its paste-ready prompt and 'Copy prompt' button; the 'output next to the recipe' layout.

recreate.how: Screen-record a browser (OBS or Screen Studio); for a polished version add a zoom-crop and rounded-corner frame in ffmpeg/Remotion.
recreate.prompt: Silent fast scroll through a white web gallery of video thumbnails, cut to a split view of a video next to the prompt that generated it.
